Track (Korean vs English): KNU admissions pages publish a single language rule per degree level with no separate English track; recorded as track ANY.

Department-specific language minimums (e.g. Media and Communication TOPIK 5, Computer Science and Engineering TOPIK 4, Korean Language and Literature TOPIK 5, Business Administration TOPIK 4) are given only as examples; the full list is in the semester admissions guide (PDF not retrieved).
Admissions guide PDFs for Spring 2027 not downloaded/parsed; scholarship page itself says '장학금과 관련된 정확한 정보는 모집요강을 참고부탁드립니다'.
Scholarship percentages for undergraduate TOPIK/KLP/merit awards are stated as approximate ('약') of 학비; recorded at the stated percentage.
Scholarship application method / automatic award not stated for any scheme (automatic = null).
GKS: no current-year quota or KNU-specific GKS numbers recorded; only schedule and tracks.

Dormitory capacity: en housing page says '2,692 rooms that accommodate 5,210 undergraduate and graduate students' (not international-specific); left capacity null. Dormitory costs are management fees only; meal plans separate.

Support services beyond visa help and the KLP buddy (orientation, airport pickup, insurance help, part-time job guidance, counseling) not recorded: OIA E-Help menu shows 'Insurance' and 'Part-time job' tabs but their content was not rendered in the fetched HTML; the 2026 English Guidebook PDF is image-only (no extractable text).
Korean Language Program tuition: en page states '1,300,000 KRW/semester(10weeks) *Will be raised to 1,400,000KRW form 2026' (not a schema field).

Videos: no dedicated international-recruitment or English admissions video found on either official channel (OIA channel RSS shows only video-contest entries; main @knu channel RSS shows Korean-language content); video spoken language not verified (language = null).

education_philosophy.heading: 교육이념 — 진리·긍지·봉사
education_philosophy.statement: 첨성대를 세운 신라인의 진리 탐구, 긍지 추구, 봉사 실천의 정신을 바탕으로 미래를 개척하고 세계를 주도하는 창의적 인재, ‘첨성인’.
education_philosophy.summary_en: Kyungpook National University states truth, pride and service as its educational philosophy, and calls the graduate it aims for a *Cheomseong-in* — after the people of Silla who built the Cheomseongdae observatory in nearby Gyeongju. Creativity, interdisciplinary thinking, reflection and communication are written out underneath it.
education_philosophy.summary_ko: 경북대학교는 진리·긍지·봉사를 교육이념으로 두고, 길러 내려는 인재상을 «첨성인»이라 부릅니다. 경주 첨성대를 세운 신라 사람들의 태도에서 가져온 이름으로, 창의·융합·성찰·소통이라는 역량을 그 아래 구체적으로 적어 두고 있습니다.
